request.query: Set of indices of bounded integer multivariate polynomials at reduced rational points with fixed denominators

items.name: MvPolynomial.schwartz_zippel_totalDegree
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq R] {n : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R},
  p ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (S : Finset R),
      ↑{f ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun x => S | (MvPolynomial.eval f) p = 0}.card / ↑S.card ^ n ≤ ↑p.totalDegree / ↑S.card

items.name: MvPolynomial.support
items.type: {R : Type u} → {σ : Type u_1} → [inst : CommSemiring R] → MvPolynomial σ R → Finset (σ →₀ ℕ)

items.name: Polynomial.support
items.type: {R : Type u} → [inst : Semiring R] → Polynomial R → Finset ℕ

items.name: MvPolynomial.schwartz_zippel_sup_sum
items.type:
∀ {R : Type u_1} [inst : CommRing R] [IsDomain R] [inst_2 : DecidableEq R] {n : ℕ} {p : MvPolynomial (Fin n) R},
  p ≠ 0 →
    ∀ (S : Fin n → Finset R),
      ↑{x ∈ Fintype.piFinset fun i => S i | (MvPolynomial.eval x) p = 0}.card / ∏ i, ↑(S i).card ≤
        p.support.sup fun s => ∑ i, ↑(s i) / ↑(S i).card
